name: backup-gauge
description: Adds a backup storage gauge to the server detail header, beside CPU, memory and disk. Shows how much of the server's backup allocation is in use.
author: Catalyst Team

refreshSeconds.description: How often the gauge re-reads backup usage, in seconds (15-3600). The panel rate-limits the backup list to 30 requests per minute, so do not go below 15.

warnPercent.description: Allocation usage (percent) at which the reading turns amber.

criticalPercent.description: Allocation usage (percent) at which the reading turns red.
